mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status, priority, created_by, assigned_to, project_id, due_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{createdBy}, #{assignedTo}, #{projectId}, #{dueDate}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, created_by = #{createdBy}, assigned_to = #{assignedTo}, project_id = #{projectId}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
